# #1000 · Fix relocatable path resolution in workflow TOOLS (bundle-relative charter/config paths)

- **State:** finished
- **Created:** 2026-09-01
- **Ended:** 2026-09-01
- **End action:** Relocatable path resolution in workflow tools FIXED: config-resolver charterHome self-locates the bundle (absolute, TPM_BUNDLE_ROOT-overridable); scaffold dropCharter fails loud; compose emits ${TPM_HOME}/ methodology paths. Tests green, E2E from repo + consumer.

**Context:** The ${TPM_HOME} fix covered skill REFERENCES but NOT the workflow tools' own path resolution. Default charter/methodology paths resolve relative to projectRoot (found via the CLAUDE.md marker = the CONSUMER root), but the real resources are vendored under $TPM_HOME/node_modules — so a consumer gets PLACEHOLDER charters + unresolvable methodology paths. Confirmed live in claude-decant. Fix pattern: framework-owned DEFAULT resources self-locate the bundle (via __dirname, like the expand hook), while consumer-config OVERRIDES stay projectRoot-relative. HOLD: shared tools are symlinked into running consumers — never edit mid-round. Audit: tmp/relocatable-tool-audit/candidates.md.
